ShellAuthopenapi_resource_yaml_component.description: 新建只允许本人L3待审草稿或L4/private个人包；level/owner/tenant由服务端决定，不能直接创建L0-L2。

value.description: 64 字节签名的 base64url 无填充编码；解码后须重编码比较，拒绝非规范尾位。

state.description: Once workspace accepts a newer selection revision, requested/resolved/applying becomes superseded. Already applied or failed rows keep the latest recorded outcome and error; appliedGeneration never replaces a later real failure.

appliedGeneration.description: Last generation genuinely observed ready. Historical rows retain this successful observation after a newer selection replaces them.

ShellAuthopenapi_resource_yaml_component.description: Shared L3 skill/tool. Plugin L0-L4/private views continue through legacy APIs, without catalog projection.
Shared L3 skill/tool only. Server derives tenant, owner and level. Private skill stays local. Plugin CRUD uses legacy APIs; catalog rejects plugin kind/IDs.

manifestDownloadPath.description: Same-origin locator for exact immutable raw manifest UTF-8 bytes, not a bearer URL. Every request checks tenant/package/version ACL; caller must verify digest/envelope. Published and draft reads use the current corresponding ACL.

ShellAuthopenapi_resource_yaml_component.description: Draft version. Reviews bind manifest digest and version revision. Published manifests and artifacts are immutable.
Catalog manifest for skill/tool. PluginManifest remains in the package format for internal migration only; catalog APIs do not expose plugin projections.

installScripts.$comment: Boolean plus not true is equivalent to const false; avoid the Java generator's invalid Boolean enum literal for const/enum false.

minimumLevel.description: Server-derived floor: command skill or any nonempty tools/outboundHosts/dataAccess is at least r2; tool at least r2, git r3. Server scans text too; declarations cannot downgrade command content.

level.description: Effective server risk. Authorized reviewers may raise it only; changes increment revision and invalidate earlier reviews.

requiredReviewers.description: Distinct non-author reviewers; one for r1, two for r2/r3. Repeated identities count once.

requiredSecurityReviewers.description: Zero for r1; at least one qualified security reviewer for r2/r3. Server verifies qualification independently of input role.

ShellAuthopenapi_resource_yaml_component.description: Read-only server assessment, recalculated on content/permission changes. Publication transaction checks the current assessment and review identities.

Draft multipart upload. expectedDigest is exact manifest bytes SHA-256. Include manifest as a binary part, plus one binary artifacts part per manifest artifact in array order. Online tools use no artifacts. Validate all hashes before committing the immutable version.
Review identity and immutable decision history for the exact version revision. Version contains kind and server risk/quorum. Failed author/qualification/quorum checks cannot approve/publish.

manifestDownloadPath.description: Same-origin path only. Reject absolute URLs, authority paths, query, fragments, percent escapes, redirects and dot segments.

installationRevision.description: Resource-assigned persisted per-installation CAS revision. Preserved by signature renewal and echoed by node/Desktop reports. Omission is transport-compatible only: never accept applied without a positive expected revision.

desiredState.description: Preferred desired state when present. If absent on legacy data, derive ENABLED/DISABLED from enabled. REMOVED is an uninstall tombstone carrying the new installationRevision, retained until a matching removed acknowledgement and retired in the next generation. Reject unknown or unspecified values.

downloadPath.description: Same-origin path only. Reject absolute URLs, authority paths, query, fragments, percent escapes, redirects and dot segments.

created.description: Unix seconds; 0 denotes an unknown creation time and is not a creation timestamp.

context_window.description: Authenticated pool context capacity, when disclosed.

max_output_tokens.description: Authenticated pool output capacity; smaller than context_window when both are disclosed.

stop.description: 首批仅接受最多4个字符串的数组，不接受单字符串stop。
